certainty.policy: Keep conditional si and possibility podría when the source expresses a condition or possibility; do not strengthen either into certainty.

protected_content_policy.numeric_literals: copy_exactly_from_source; do not localize punctuation in protected prices, percentages, dates, indicators, levels, hashes, URLs or filenames
protected_content_policy.trade_system_tokens: copy_exactly_from_source; this includes tickers, timeframes, BUY, SELL, WAIT_TRIGGER, OCO, Trigger and Entry
protected_content_policy.causality: do not add a causal relation or investment recommendation absent from the source
